question: Which of the following metabolites is a gluconeogenic substrate:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Glycerol -> converted to glycerol-3-phosphate -> enters gluconeogenesis pathway -> 80% CHAIN: Acetyl-CoA -> converted to malonyl-CoA -> inhibits gluconeogenesis -> 70% CHAIN: Ethanol -> metabolized to acetaldehyde -> converted to acetyl-CoA -> can enter gluconeogenesis -> 75% CHAIN: Oleic acid -> undergoes beta-oxidation -> produces acetyl-CoA -> can enter gluconeogenesis -> 70% CHAIN: NADPH + H+ -> not a direct gluconeogenic substrate -> 80%
analysis: Glycerol is a gluconeogenic substrate as it can be converted to glucose through gluconeogenesis pathway.
